data.name: Raushan
data.gender_notes: Raushan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raushan is a Persian name that means 'illuminated' or 'enlightened'. It symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth. The name Raushan carries the meaning “Illuminated, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Raushan usually hope their child will grow to embody illuminated, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Raushan is associated with the concept of Nur, or divine light, which is mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Raushan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Illuminated, Enlightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raushan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: روشن

in_hindi.name: रोशन
in_hindi.long_meaning: रोशन नाम का अर्थ है प्रकाश का स्रोत, और यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो अज्ञानता को दूर करते हैं और सच्चाई की पहचान कराते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बुद्धिमत्ता, समझदारी और आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: روښان
